subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom

Leave no stone unturned

options.text: To share a secret that wasn't suppose to be shared
The final event in a series of unacceptable actions
To act in a frenzied manner

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 4.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"Leave no stone unturned"** means to make all possible efforts to achieve something or to search for something thoroughly. (कोई कसर नहीं छोड़ना) • **Example: **The police **left no stone unturned** in their search for the missing child. • **Make all possible efforts** refers to trying everything possible to achieve a desired outcome. (सभी संभव प्रयास करना) • **Example: **He **made all possible efforts **to secure a good job after graduation. • Hence, we can infer that the meaning of **'Leave no stone unturned'** is to **'make all possible efforts'**. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1: To share a secret that wasn't suppose to be shared** (गुप्त बात साझा करना जो नहीं की जानी चाहिए थी): • **Example:** She accidentally shared a secret that wasn't supposed to be shared with anyone. • **Option 2: The final event in a series of unacceptable actions** (अस्वीकार्य कार्यों की श्रृंखला में अंतिम घटना): • **Example: **The final insult was the last straw in a series of unacceptable actions. • **Option 3: To act in a frenzied manner** (उन्मत्त तरीके से कार्य करना): • **Example:** He acted in a frenzied manner when he heard the news. 36:Tb52, The correct answer is: **Option 2.**
